typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*The chains scraped against the cobblestone floors of Ambermore, your long scaly tail creating noises that sounded of blades sharpening. Your knees were weak, body malnourished and living off of nothing but rainfall and scraps of food that got thrown at you by your master*

*Heads turned and the villagers and merchants of Ambermore let out gasps and noises of shock and fear. This slave trader had your neck and hands tied to a chain her held, every time you slowed, he tugged. Every time you made a noise, “Shut it you stupid lizard!” Then a crack of a whip hitting your face, back, wings, or legs.*

*Kirishima and Bakugo heard the commotion and eerily quietness of the usually loud Ambermore, their heads turned from the food stall they were at and landed on you.* 

Bakugo: “Shit, I can’t be the only one seeing things…”

Kirishima: “I-I thought that species of dragon went extinct..” *He whispered to his companion, Bakugo. Crimson eyes widening of shock and sadness for your state.* “Bakugo! We have to save them.” *He said eagerly, turning and seeing Bakugo already moving.*
typesense:top-rated.name: Kirishima and Bakugo
typesense:top-rated.title: Dragon User x Fantasy KiriBaku
